articles.title: India News | DGHS Medical Procurement Scam: 'Tender Files Destroyed Intentionally,' Rs 839 Crores Paid to 5 Beneficiary Companies, Claims ACB
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. The Anti-Corruption Branch (ACB) on Thursday alleged that tender files were intentionally destroyed by the accused persons in the DGHS medical procurement case. In its chargesheet, ACB also claimed that bills were not prepared through GeM and payment of Rs 839 crore was made to five beneficiary companies.

articles.title: ACB Alleges Destruction of Tender Files in DGHS Medical Scam Case
articles.description: The ACB has charged former DGHS officials and a private firm in a massive procurement scam involving Rs 839 crore, alleging intentional destruction of critical tender files and the purchase of equipment at highly inflated prices.

articles.title: GeM Cuts Transaction Charges to 0.30%, Raises Exemption Threshold to ₹10 Lakh for MSEs
